summary: A timeless pear-shaped solitaire with eagle-claw prongs, a hidden diamond halo and a slim 1.8 mm band in 14K white gold.
description:
A timeless pear-shaped solitaire with a delicate hidden halo tucked beneath the centre stone, adding an unexpected touch of sparkle from every angle. Elegant eagle-claw prongs keep the pear-shaped centre as the focus.

Crafted in polished 14K white gold with a slim 1.8 mm band, the setting feels delicate while showcasing the diamond. The hidden halo adds brilliance beneath the centre while keeping a clean solitaire view from above.

Starting at $2,500 CAD with a 1.00 ct pear-shaped centre diamond. Centre diamond size and metal can be customized on request; tell us your preferences for a personal quote.
